name: Infinite Word Loop
description: Vertical looping word slot where words glide past a framed highlight box that resizes to the current word, with elastic GSAP stepping and an optional grid backdrop.
contents: Looping list of words scrolling vertically through a masked window
Corner-bracket indicator box that matches the current word width
behavior: Words loop endlessly without duplication using a GSAP scrubbed timeline
Each step advances with an elastic ease then pauses
Indicator width animates to the active word
Font size scales fluidly with viewport width
editableByProps: Words, text size level, text color, indicator color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the grid cell size or mask direction
needsCodeEdit.where: The showGrid block with the linear-gradient background

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how far words travel per step
needsCodeEdit.where: yPercent values inside the paddedLines forEach

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Grid backdrop is position fixed across the whole viewport
Text and grid colors follow the page color scheme (canvasText) unless textColor is set
The emoji word gets a fixed 1.5em width
